rationale: HR software shouldn't feel like a cold corporate database. Using warm terracotta, sage green, and bone white creates a tactile, human-centric environment that builds trust, reduces stress, and feels premium.

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl tracking-tight leading-none font-semibold text-[#2A2624]
rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl tracking-tight leading-tight font-medium text-[#2A2624]

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing: Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs. Elements should breathe.

surface_styles.header: bg-[#FDFBF9]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#E8E2D9] z-50 sticky top-0

buttons.secondary: bg-white text-[#2A2624] border border-[#E8E2D9] hover:border-[#D96C5B] hover:text-[#D96C5B]

components.inputs: bg-white border border-[#E8E2D9] rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#D96C5B]/20 focus:border-[#D96C5B] text-base
components.tables: Shadcn Table heavily customized. No vertical borders. Header row background #F9F6F0. Text color #2A2624.
components.tabs: Shadcn Tabs, h-auto, clear active state using #D96C5B text and underline.

animations.page_transition: framer-motion fade in and slide up slightly (y: 10 -> 0)

icon_style: Duotone or Regular weight, matched to text color or primary color.

login_background.description: Warm, abstract organic shapes overlapping for the login screen hero/split view

empty_state_clipboard.description: Minimalist 3D clay clipboard for empty states in tasks, approvals, or leaves

empty_state_plant.description: Minimalist 3D clay plant for generic empty states or successful onboardings

company_logo_placeholder.description: Abstract logo to use as the default company branding in the sidebar header

specific_instructions_for_main_agent: COLOR ENFORCEMENT: Do not use generic blue/grey tech colors. Use the exact hex codes provided in this JSON. Tint grays with warmth.
SPACING: The UI should feel tactile and human. Apply the generous spacing (p-6/p-8) to cards. Do not cram data.
COMPONENTS: Avoid the standard 'Vercel' look for Shadcn components. Override Shadcn defaults to match the rounded-2xl border radius and warm borders.
LAYOUT: Implement the 'Control Room' grid layout for the HR metrics dashboard, but with gap-6 instead of tight gaps, to let the data breathe.
IMAGES: For avatars, use the provided employee_avatars URLs. Do not use random placeholder text or dummyimage.com. Use the 3D clay assets for empty states.
TESTING: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='leave-apply-button').
ACCESSIBILITY: Ensure text contrast over the warm sand backgrounds meets WCAG AA standards.
LABOUR LAWS: Future-proof the UI by designing flexible, card-based compliance widgets (e.g., PF, ESIC tracking) that use the success/warning colors appropriately.
